description: M3: Cross-feature function name collision detected during post-processing

state.note: Both auth and sso features have a scenario producing function_name 'test_login'. The ScenarioInfo function names are unique per-feature but collide cross-feature. Collisions are detected during post-processing after all features are computed.

stimulus.contract: Status Reporting: post-processing collects all ScenarioInfo.function_name across features and detects duplicates. Collision entities added to StatusReport.collisions. Collisions are warnings — they do NOT affect feature stage or exit code.
stimulus.question: Does the status command detect cross-feature function name collisions and report them without affecting exit code or feature stages?
